summary: InferAll is an OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible AI gateway. New accounts get 25 free NVIDIA NIM calls with no card. The current pricing FAQ says open models then stay free at 25 calls a day (reset 00:00 UTC), and a one-time $5 activation (which becomes spendable balance, not a fee) raises that to the free plan's 50 chat calls a day. As of 2026-10-27 the Free plan card says the same, but the Activation card still calls the $5 the "cheapest path to unlock ongoing free use", so the no-payment 25/day allowance needs confirmation. The 10+ NIM open-source models (Nemotron, GLM 5.3 and others; consult the live catalog) are $0 input/output within daily caps of 50 chat / 100 text / 20 image-analyze / 10 image-generate / 5 video-generate per day. Catalog presence and zero listed prices are not a redeemed inference test.
claim_steps: Create an account and get an API key at inferall.ai/keys — no card for the first 25 NIM calls.
Check https://api.inferall.ai/ai/v1/models for currently listed $0 NIM model IDs, then call the OpenAI-compatible or Anthropic-compatible endpoint with one of those IDs.

After the 25-call trial, the Free card and FAQ say open models stay free at 25 calls a day (reset 00:00 UTC). A one-time $5 activation raises chat to 50 calls a day and becomes spendable balance; the Activation card still says it unlocks ongoing free use.
